scope: Useful scalar/categorical concepts for small-area planetary screening; not a claim that every layer is globally valid or implemented
readiness_meaning: verified_transport means a numeric or spatial API response was observed. It does not establish full scientific validation, cross-body equivalence, or demo implementation.

priorities.P1: Illumination, ice/resource proxies, geology and regional hazards

variables.label: Local-noon bolometric surface temperature
variables.notes: Composite Diviner surface brightness temperature, not air temperature or current weather. Source compilation 2009-07-05 to 2015-04-01. Service spacing 0.5 degree (~15.2 km at equator); some prose inconsistently says 0.5 ppd. Absolute-temperature conversion to Celsius is K-273.15; mask source missing values before conversion.

variables.label: Local-midnight bolometric surface temperature
variables.notes: Composite Diviner surface brightness temperature, not air temperature or current weather. Source compilation 2009-07-05 to 2015-04-01. variables.label: Maximum-minus-minimum surface temperature
variables.notes: Difference requires spatially matched valid source pixels. No Celsius offset for a temperature difference.

variables.label: Long-term sunlight visibility fraction
variables.notes: Polar coverage; 240/60 m service pixels. Long-term modeled visibility, typically the 18.6-year nutation cycle; specify observer height/reference and epoch. Not instantaneous insolation.

variables.label: Long-term Earth visibility fraction
variables.notes: Polar coverage; 240/60 m service pixels. Any visible part of Earth can count, so this does not establish a usable DSN/radio link.

variables.label: Intersection with mapped permanently shadowed region
variables.notes: Polar vector polygons; sample a point or intersect a window. Polygon quality/coverage fields matter.

variables.label: Proximity to mapped surface-ice detection
variables.notes: Detection points on a nominal 280 m product. An empty result is not evidence of ice absence; radius must be explicit.

variables.label: Geologic unit and description
variables.notes: Queryable global polygons; preserve USGS unit code, description and interpretation. Codes are not interchangeable with Earth or Mars lithology codes.

variables.label: Olivine abundance
variables.notes: Coverage 50S-50N. Numeric service and samples report 0.25-degree spacing (~7.6 km at equator), despite source imagery advertised at 512 ppd (~59 m). A fine pixelSize request still returned 0.25 degree. Four mineral raw fractions sum to approximately one at all three probe locations, whereas FGDC calls them wt%. Multiply by 100 only under an explicit, reviewed normalization; do not label raw 0.066 as 0.066 wt%.

variables.label: Clinopyroxene abundance
variables.notes: Coverage 50S-50N. Numeric service and samples report 0.25-degree spacing (~7.6 km at equator), despite source imagery advertised at 512 ppd (~59 m). A fine pixelSize request still returned 0.25 degree. Same fraction-versus-wt% scaling issue as olivine.

variables.label: Orthopyroxene abundance
variables.notes: Coverage 50S-50N. Numeric service and samples report 0.25-degree spacing (~7.6 km at equator), despite source imagery advertised at 512 ppd (~59 m). A fine pixelSize request still returned 0.25 degree. Same fraction-versus-wt% scaling issue as olivine.

variables.label: Plagioclase abundance
variables.notes: Coverage 50S-50N. Numeric service and samples report 0.25-degree spacing (~7.6 km at equator), despite source imagery advertised at 512 ppd (~59 m). A fine pixelSize request still returned 0.25 degree. Same scaling issue; mature soils can bias mineral interpretation, so retain OMAT and fit quality.

variables.label: Iron oxide abundance
variables.notes: Coverage 50S-50N. Numeric service and samples report 0.25-degree spacing (~7.6 km at equator), despite source imagery advertised at 512 ppd (~59 m). A fine pixelSize request still returned 0.25 degree. FGDC explicitly defines FeO wt%; raw samples are approximately 6.8-20.4 in this audit.

variables.label: Submicroscopic metallic iron abundance
variables.notes: Coverage 50S-50N. Numeric service and samples report 0.25-degree spacing (~7.6 km at equator), despite source imagery advertised at 512 ppd (~59 m). A fine pixelSize request still returned 0.25 degree. Raw 2.9-6.9; source labels do not resolve the raw service scaling. Do not publish a physical abundance yet.

variables.label: Optical maturity index (OMAT)
variables.notes: Coverage 50S-50N. Numeric service and samples report 0.25-degree spacing (~7.6 km at equator), despite source imagery advertised at 512 ppd (~59 m). A fine pixelSize request still returned 0.25 degree. Space-weathering/composition context; not an Earth soil-maturity index.

variables.label: Modeled plagioclase grain size
variables.notes: Coverage 50S-50N. Numeric service and samples report 0.25-degree spacing (~7.6 km at equator), despite source imagery advertised at 512 ppd (~59 m). A fine pixelSize request still returned 0.25 degree. Spectral-model parameter for plagioclase; not measured bulk soil particle size.

variables.label: Mineral-model weighted fit criterion
variables.notes: Coverage 50S-50N. Numeric service and samples report 0.25-degree spacing (~7.6 km at equator), despite source imagery advertised at 512 ppd (~59 m). A fine pixelSize request still returned 0.25 degree. Quality/provenance channel, not a resource or environmental score. NaN observed at one probe; no universal quality cutoff established.

variables.label: Thorium abundance
variables.notes: Very coarse geochemical context; tested service spacings 1 and 0.5 degree. Not a local radiation-dose estimate.

variables.label: Elemental titanium abundance
variables.notes: FGDC defines elemental Ti wt%, not TiO2. Service spacing 2 degrees (~61 km); product name is not a reliable ppd declaration.

variables.label: KPLO potassium channel
variables.notes: Numeric samples verified; 2-degree service grid. Raw physical scaling/unit unresolved.

variables.label: KPLO uranium channel
variables.notes: Numeric samples verified; 2-degree service grid. Raw physical scaling/unit unresolved.

variables.label: Thermal-neutron channel
variables.notes: Numeric channel, not temperature or water abundance. Detector normalization/units unresolved.

variables.label: Polar water-equivalent-hydrogen proxy
variables.notes: North samples verified at 5 km spacing; south endpoint timed out. Confirm raw abundance scaling before exposing %. Hydrogen does not uniquely establish accessible water ice.

variables.label: Modeled ice-stability depth
variables.notes: North samples verified at 240 m spacing, some exactly 2.5; possible cap/sentinel requires source documentation. South endpoint timed out. Modeled stability, not measured depth to an ice deposit.

variables.label: Radar circular polarization ratio
variables.notes: Polar 118 m grid. Roughness and material properties affect CPR; elevated CPR alone is not ice confirmation.

variables.label: Radar S1 backscatter
variables.notes: Polar 118 m service. Do not mix its positive linear values with the separate Malapert dB product.

variables.label: Incidence-normalized Malapert radar backscatter
variables.notes: Small south-polar region; FGDC defines dB. Metadata title says CPR but abstract and S1 layer describe backscatter; retain that ambiguity.

variables.label: Christiansen-feature wavelength
variables.notes: Composition proxy, 60S-60N, 1/128-degree service grid (~237 m equator). Metadata min contains invalid negative wavelengths; enforce documented masks, not a generic numeric check.

variables.label: Regional detected-rock count
variables.notes: Site B only. Exact FGDC defines detected-rock counts in each 100 m by 100 m pixel; not rock area fraction. Detection completeness and source missing mask still matter.

variables.label: Regional Site C rock channel
variables.notes: Site C is U2 with sampled 0/1; exact FGDC was empty. Do not infer a fraction or transfer Site B encoding without confirmation.

variables.label: Regional NAC terrain roughness
variables.notes: Regional raster with 1.5 m postings; 15 m is a processing baseline in its name, not pixel spacing. Verify roughness definition and units before comparison.

variables.label: Published regional lunar slope
variables.notes: Only southern latitude bands for services checked; postings about119m for the working layer despite 60mpp name. Kagyua endpoint returned invalid-parameter error on sample probe; do not advertise it as working.

variables.label: Photometrically defined surface albedo
variables.notes: Useful for heating and surface context; no calibrated numeric lunar albedo service was verified in this audit. Do not infer it from basemap brightness.

variables.label: Regolith thermal inertia / thermal-property model
variables.notes: Useful for material and thermal analogues. Published Diviner products exist, but an appropriate quantitative small-cutout endpoint and exact definition still need verification.

variables.label: Diviner-scale surface rock area fraction
variables.notes: Distinct from NAC detected-rock counts. Published thermal-model rock-abundance products exist; quantitative cutout and quality mask were not verified here.

variables.label: Modeled crustal grain density
variables.notes: Geophysical/model context, low priority for surface Earth-analogue matching. Unit/model version/normalization must be pinned before frontend exposure; grain density is not surface bulk regolith density.

variables.label: Modeled annual approximate mean surface temperature
variables.notes: KRC v2.3.2 model using TES albedo; 8 ppd (~7.4 km equator). Samples at 5am/1pm and 10-degree solar-longitude increments; mean is approximate [day+night]/2. Not measured current weather, air temperature, or an exhaustive diurnal extreme.

variables.label: Modeled annual minimum surface temperature
variables.notes: KRC v2.3.2 model using TES albedo; 8 ppd (~7.4 km equator). Samples at 5am/1pm and 10-degree solar-longitude increments; mean is approximate [day+night]/2. Not measured current weather, air temperature, or an exhaustive diurnal extreme.

variables.label: Modeled annual maximum-minus-minimum surface temperature
variables.notes: Do not use mars_yearly_temperature_range_celsius directly: all 64 probe pixels equal (max-min)-273.15 within float rounding, producing negative ranges. Derive max-min from matching valid extrema instead.

variables.label: TES Lambert albedo
variables.notes: 8 ppd (~7.4 km equator). Reflectance under a specific photometric convention; not a generic RGB brightness or universally interchangeable Earth albedo.

variables.label: TES apparent thermal inertia
variables.notes: 8 ppd product; preserve model/version/quality and distinguish from Putzig day/night alternatives.

variables.label: TES Putzig nighttime apparent thermal inertia

metadata.name: TES_TI_Putzig_night_numeric
metadata.title: TES Night Side Thermal Inertia (Putzig and Mellon 2007)

variables.notes: 20 ppd service grid (~3 km equator); model alternative to Christensen TES map, not an additional independent physical property.

variables.label: THEMIS apparent thermal inertia

metadata.name: thm_ti_100m_32bit
metadata.title: THEMIS Quantitative Thermal Inertia 100m Global Mosaic (32-bit)

variables.notes: Nominal100m / max593ppd. Quantitative32bit mosaic; mask-32768 and report actual valid support. Different scenes/epochs are mosaicked.

variables.label: TES surface dust-cover index
variables.notes: 16ppd (~3.7km equator). Distinct from atmospheric dust opacity and mineral-model surface-dust fraction. Source NullValue must be respected.

variables.label: Odyssey neutron-derived water-equivalent hydrogen
variables.notes: 2ppd (~29.6km equator), with much larger measurement/reconstruction support possible. Hydrogen-equivalent proxy, not direct surface ice fraction or recoverable resource mass.

variables.label: TES Olivine spectral-model abundance
variables.notes: 4ppd (~14.8km equator); source NODATA=-1, not zero. Spectral-mixture model fraction, not elemental wt%; compare only with a compatible terrestrial measurement.

variables.label: USGS geologic unit and description
variables.notes: Trek SIM3292_Global_Geology categorical polygons; ASU numeric map codes require a legend. Only the first non-group layer was probed; inspect all sublayer semantics and mapping completeness before aggregating.

variables.label: Mapped hydrous-mineral detections
variables.notes: Trek CRISM/OMEGA detections and aqueous-mineral classes. An empty query is no observation, not absence or zero abundance. Only the first non-group layer was probed; inspect all sublayer semantics and mapping completeness before aggregating.

variables.label: Mapped chloride-bearing-material detections
variables.notes: Trek THEMIS chloride detections; no concentration field established. Only the first non-group layer was probed; inspect all sublayer semantics and mapping completeness before aggregating.

variables.label: Regional subsurface ice-consistency evidence
variables.notes: SWIM regional products are evidence/model scores, not probabilities or a globally valid ice-depth/fraction measurement; cutout access needs separate verification.

variables.label: Mapped dune-field context
variables.notes: Trek feature mapping; availability outside mapped features is unknown, not zero sand cover. Only the first non-group layer was probed; inspect all sublayer semantics and mapping completeness before aggregating.

variables.label: Mapped valley-network context
variables.notes: Trek feature mapping; morphology and paleoenvironments, not present liquid water. Only the first non-group layer was probed; inspect all sublayer semantics and mapping completeness before aggregating.

variables.label: Mapped fans, glaciers and gullies
variables.notes: Trek feature catalog; distinguish separate classes and mapping coverage. Only the first non-group layer was probed; inspect all sublayer semantics and mapping completeness before aggregating.

variables.label: TES/Viking modeled rock abundance
variables.notes: Published products exist, but no calibrated numeric point/cutout was verified in this audit. Do not substitute thermal inertia or browse RGB.

variables.label: Seasonal/time-dependent atmosphere model variables
variables.notes: Require explicit local time, season, altitude and atmospheric model; no static Trek lookup verified. Keep separate from surface temperatures.
